tagline: YouTube links to MP3 — paste and press Download
input_hint:
Paste YouTube links here — one per line.
Whole playlists work too.
err_unavailable: Video is unavailable or was removed.
err_bot: YouTube is temporarily blocking requests. Try again later.
err_checksum: Downloaded file is damaged. Try again.
no_links: No links found. Copy a YouTube link, then press Paste.
setup_text:
One-time setup: downloading the download engine (about 65 MB).
This happens only on the first launch.
setup_failed: Couldn't download the components. Check your internet connection.
update_hint: Many errors? Try again tomorrow — the engine updates itself daily.
new_version: New version {v} available — click to download
confirm_close: A download is in progress. Quit anyway?
legal: Only download content you have the right to.
